runtime.description: The Fortress commands the marsh through durable beasts, fast flyers, and attrition tactics. Beastmasters and witches favor survival, disruption, and their Hunting Grounds over high magic.

allowedDebt: Fortress is currently a loadable scaffold; town layers, build-tree icons, law icons, specialization icons, and several unit mechanics are not release-quality yet.

Fortress Tears of Ashan alternate-upgrade source sprites are tracked in homm3_runtime_assets/toa_unit_sources/homm3_fortress, and distinct import rows/bundles are present in the source plugin. Keep validating source identity, but do not describe standard-upgrade bundle reuse as the current blocker.
Fortress intentionally shares Human and Dungeon donors with Tower and Stronghold. Reverse lookup must remain context-required.
